basic_info.description: Behind this classic Victorian facade awaits a modern two-level house-like condominium in a small 2-unit association. Located in a prime Potrero Hill location, the updated home features  extra tall ceilings, inlaid hardwood floors, custom doors and windows and recessed lighting. The spacious living/dining/great room boast a handsome gas fireplace and overlooks the landscaped garden. The modern chef's kitchen boasts new quartz counters, a center island and high-end stainless appliances. The main level features a large bedroom with bay window and updated spa-like bathroom. The upper level features a primary suite and sun porch with bay and Bay Bridge Views. The primary bath is newly updated with a new shower, vanity and custom tile. A third bedroom features downtown, city and Twin Peaks views. The home opens to a beautiful, shared landscaped garden and patio with mature foliage. Ideal Potrero Hill location close to numerous parks, community gardens, schools and world class restaurants, cafes and shopping along 18th Street. Close to the Mission, Mission Bay and easy access to public transit and freeways. Some photos may be edited or altered.
